title: Postdoctoral Research Associate in Large-scale dynamics for strongly interacting particle systems
about: 24-month full-time fixed-term postdoctoral post at the Oxford Mathematical Institute with Professor Maria Bruna, on large-scale dynamics of strongly interacting particle systems. Start date flexible between January and October 2027.
requirements: Two references must reach the portal by the closing date
